I just answered a similar question on StackOverflow

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/30721081/skipping-a-value-between-min-and-max-values-when-using-selectinput-function-in-s/30721832#30721832

Read my full notes though, it's not a clean solution, I'm sure it can be much nicer but I didn't spend any time on trying to do it right, I just showed a proof-of-concept how to do it with javascript.  You might also be able to do it by simply adding a `data-values` attribute to the slider input tag (read the post on SO and the rangeslider docs for more info)
